prompt:
According to the company procedures in the knowledge base, create a new Jira issue in project SUP.

Summary subject: AI agents to streamline document retrieval
Main developer: Asier Cidon
Assignee / author note: Roman Martin
Description: We are implementing an innovative capability that integrates autonomous AI agents into our internal workflows to streamline document retrieval from the central database.

Steps:
1. Use file_search to retrieve the New Jira Issue Creation procedure.
2. Create the issue with jira MCP tools following that procedure.
3. Report the created issue key from the tool response.

arguments.summary: AI agents to streamline document retrieval
arguments.description: We are implementing an innovative capability that integrates autonomous AI agents into our internal workflows to streamline document retrieval from the central database.

requests.trajectory:
1. mcp_list_tools  tools=[jira_get_issue, jira_search, jira_get_project_issues, jira_create_issue, jira_batch_create_issues, jira_batch_get_changelogs, jira_update_issue, jira_assign_issue, jira_delete_issue, jira_move_issue]
2. mcp_call name=jira_create_issue status=error args={"project_key": "SUP", "summary": "AI agents to streamline document retrieval", "issue_type": "Task", "description": "We are implementing an innovative capability that integrates autonomous AI agents into our internal workflows to streamline document retrieval from the central database.", "additional_fields": "{", "components": "", "attachments": ""}
